dedupe_keys.name: comparatif des consommations energetiques du parc immobilier de la province de luxembourg en 2015

description: Comparatif des consommations énergétiques du parc immobilier de la Province de Luxembourg en 2015 is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Province de Luxembourg. Liste des bâtiments dont est propriétaire la Province de Luxembourg avec leur superficie habitable et leur consommation en chauffage (années: 2011 à 2015) interprétée en KwH et permettant d'extrapoler la performance énergétique en KwH/m2. Coverage: Province of Luxembourg (Wallonia). The portal files it under Urbanisme, Patrimoine. Its keywords are performance, énergétique, province, luxembourg. The portal shows 69 records. The portal shows 2023-08-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support building stock, energy use and retrofit studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
